description: Create a design (a full-screen slide for a screen, such as a menu, an announcement or an event poster) from a description. It picks a fitting template, fills in the text and adds stock photos where the template has them; no images are generated with AI. The design is saved in the team's files and can be shown on a screen or used in a scene. Each design uses the account's AI budget, with at most 20 designs per hour.

brief.description: What the design must show, in the user's words, with all texts, prices, times and names to put on it. For a list whose entries are not known yet, give the number of entries as digits ("a menu with 10 dishes"); never placeholders or made-up names: the designer adds placeholders itself.

language.description: Two-letter language code of the texts on the design (en, nl, de, ...).

name.description: Name of the design in Screenbird. Optional.

name: create_design
title: Create a design
